hook.quote: “We won’t attack.” If so, their role must be that of a “shield.”

flow.quote: So far, the explanation is easy to understand: “The Typhoons are a shield.”

surprise_structure.quote: But if we try to fit all of the UK’s support into that box, the lid will not close.

readability_pull.quote: “Wait. Wasn’t the claim that they wouldn’t attack?”

no_unnatural_staging.quote: But if we try to fit all of the UK’s support into that box, the lid will not close.

hook.quote: Fighter jets are coming. But they won’t attack.

flow.quote: The UK also says it will extend air-refueling support for Saudi Arabia’s air defense operations.

surprise_structure.quote: Also, this is what the UK announced about its missions and support. It is not a report that all of them have already been carried out.

readability_pull.quote: “Wait a minute. Didn’t you say you wouldn’t attack?”

no_unnatural_staging.quote: those words belong to the “Typhoon mission” seat.

hook.quote: Britain is sending fighter jets, but not to attack the other side.

flow.quote: If that were all, the story might end with “the jets are being sent to defend.”

surprise_structure.quote: The first thing to note is that this was the coalition’s account. It was not a report that British Typhoons had intercepted the missile.

readability_pull.quote: The fighter jets are what draw the eye. But it was the refueling that showed how far Britain’s support reaches.

no_unnatural_staging.quote: The mission to protect cities and the support for operations to weaken military targets need to be read separately.

hook.quote: “Won’t attack.” At that one line, you were about to end the meeting in your head with the conclusion, “So Britain will only defend.”

flow.quote: But the announcement mentions another task too: refueling in the air.

surprise_structure.quote: It is like someone saying, “I won’t drive,” while helping put fuel in a car.

readability_pull.quote: “Wait! You just said they wouldn’t attack, right?”

no_unnatural_staging.quote: This time, it’s the news detective’s turn to track down the subject.
